items.question: Is the full Sublustrum remake out?
items.answer: Steam lists Q1 2027 and marks the full game as coming soon. The October 12–25, 2026 open playtest covers Chapter One. Checked October 13, 2026.

items.question: How do I join the Sublustrum playtest?
items.answer: Open Sublustrum on Steam (app 4151300), use Request Access in the playtest section, and check your Steam library after access is granted.

items.question: Can I use an Outcry walkthrough for this playtest?
items.answer: Only as historical reference. The 2008 original uses fixed-screen point-and-click exploration; the remake rebuilds locations for free 3D movement and revises puzzles.

items.question: Where is the complete Chapter One walkthrough?
items.answer: We have not yet verified a complete route for the October build. Published guides cover confirmed access, preparation and device feedback; they do not present old puzzle codes as remake answers.

items.question: Who develops and publishes the remake?
items.answer: The current Steam listing names Brickworks Games as developer and HypeTrain Digital as publisher. Phantomery Interactive is associated with the original game.
